status_summary: The administration's fiscal year 2026 budget request proposed cutting roughly $308 million from the program, as discussed at a Senate appropriations subcommittee hearing on 2025-05-15, where the Secretary said DOT would look for efficiencies. Congress did not adopt the cut: the FY2026 Transportation-HUD appropriations, enacted in the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 (H.R. 7148) signed on 2026-02-03, provide $513.6 million for the program, which the Senate committee described as full funding. No proposal to end the program entirely was found.
